newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Mecrastor joins Coopers & Lybrand.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Mecrastor joins Coopers & Lybrand.

text.p: Finnish management consultancy group Mecrastor Oy said on Tuesday it had joined the British-based international accountancy firm Coopers & Lybrand via a share deal made for an undisclosed sum.

"By this corporate sale, the majority of Mecrastor Oy's shares are being transferred to the Coopers & Lybrand group with the previous owners continuing as minority shareholders," Mecrastor said in a statement.

Mecrastor said its managing director, Asa-Matti Lyytinen would continue to serve as managing director of the new Mecrastor Coopers & Lybrand Oy, and that its 50 consultants would also remain with the new company.
Mecrastor Coopers & Lybrand's annual invoicing would be about 40 million markka, it said.
